content: ध्रुव {%a.%} .²1 .³({%a%}) Fixed, firm, immovable, stable, permanent, constant, unchangeable; इति ध्रुवेच्छामनुशासती सुताम् <ls>Ku. 5. 5</ls>. .³({%b%}) Perpetual, everlasting, eternal; ध्रुवेण भर्त्रा <ls>Ku. 7. 85</ls>; <ls>Ms. 7. 208</ls>. .²2 Fixed (in astrology). .²3 Certain, sure, inevitable; जातस्य हि ध्रुवो मृत्युर्ध्रुवं जन्म मृतस्य च <ls>Bg. 2. 27</ls>; यो ध्रुवाणि परित्यज्य अध्रुवं परिषेवते <ls>Chāṇ. 63</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 419</ls>. .²4 Retentive, tenacious; as in ध्रुवा स्मृति <ls>Ch. Up. 7. 26. 2</ls>. .²5 Strong, fixed, settled (as a day). .{@-वः@} .²1 The polar star; शरत्प्रसन्नैर्ज्योतिर्भिर्विभावर्य इव ध्रुवम् (अन्वयुः) <ls>R. 17. 35</ls>, <ls n="R.">18. 34</ls>; ध्रुवेण भर्त्रा ध्रुवदर्शनाय प्रयुज्यमाना प्रियदर्शनेन (सा दृष्टा) <ls>Ku. 7. 85</ls>. .²2 The pole of any great circle. .²3 The distance of a planet from the beginning of the sidereal zodiac, polar longitude. .²4 The Indian figtree. .²5 A post, stake. .²6 The stem or trunk (of a tree lopped off). .²7 The introductory stanza of a song (repeated as a kind of chorus; see <ls>Gīt.</ls>). .²8 Time, epoch, era. .²9 An epithet of Brahmā. .²10 Of Viṣṇu. .²11 Of Śiva. .²12 A constant arc. .²13 The tip of the nose. .²14 A sacrificial vessel. .²15 <ab>N.</ab> of the son of Uttānapāda and grandson of Manu. [Dhruva is the polar star, but personified in mythology as the son of Uttānapāda. The account of the elevation of an ordinary mortal to the position of the polar star runs thus: Uttānapāda had two wives, Suruchi and Sunīti, but the latter was disliked by him. Suruchi had a son named Uttama, and Sunīti gave birth to Dhruva. One day the boy tried, like his elder brother, to take a seat in his fatherʼs lap, but he was contemptuously treated both by the King and his favourite wife. The poor child went sobbing to its mother who told him in consolatory terms that fortune and favour were not attainable without hard exertions. At these words the youth left the paternal roof, retired to the woods, and, though quite a lad, performed such rigorous austerities that he was at last raised by Viṣṇu to the position of the Polar Star.] .²16 Peg <ls>Nm.</ls> .²17 <ab>N.</ab> of an astrological yoga (<ls>Nm.</ls>). .{@-वम्@} .²1 The sky, atmosphere. .²2 Heaven. .²3 The fixed point (from which a departure takes place); <ls>P. I. 4. 24</ls>. .²4 A certain Yoga (अमृतसिद्धि); सेनामाज्ञापयामासुर्नक्षत्रेऽहनि च ध्रुवे <ls>Mb. 14. 63. 18</ls>. (<ab>Com.</ab> रोहिण्यामुत्तररात्रये च अहनि वारे ध्रुवे रविवारे उत्तरार्केऽमृतसिद्धियोगे). .{@-वा@} .²1 A sacrificial ladle (made of wood); साधारण्यान्न ध्रुवायां स्यात् <ls>Jaimini S.</ls> .²2 A virtuous woman. .²3 A cow who stands still when being milked; सहस्रं धारा द्रविणस्य मे दुहां ध्रुवेव धेनुरनपस्फुरन्ती <ls>Av. 12. 1. 45</ls>. .²4 A bow-string. .²5 clapping the hands together to show a particular measure of time in music; स्रुचि मौर्व्यां तालभेदे स्त्रियाम् <ls>Nm.</ls> .²6 The upper quarter (ऊर्ध्व); किंदेवतोऽस्यां ध्रुवायां दिशि <ls>Bṛ. Up. 3. 9. 24</ls>. (MWʼs meaning is अधरदिशा ?) .{@-वम्@} {%ind.%} Certainly, surely, verily; <ls>R. 8. 49</ls>; ध्रुवं स नीलोत्पलपत्रधारया समिल्लतां छेत्तुमृषिर्व्यवस्यति <ls>Ś. 1. 18</ls>.
